description.content: If you are building a private OAuth app, it's likely easier to use Client Credentials rather than OAuth2.0 refresh tokens. Use the request in this folder to retreive an access_token for your private OAuth app using client credentials. The request includes a Postman script to add the returned access_token as a variable in the collection. To use this token in subsequent requests, adjust the authorization of the request to Bearer Token and add {{client_credentials_token}} in the token field.
